title: Invoices already in QuickBooks Online keep the text they were sent with
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a test location whose QuickBooks Online connection is active, linked to a QuickBooks sandbox company you can sign in to.
  • Have an invoice made and synced to QuickBooks before this release, invoice A, for customer A, whose labor line, line 1, had a title, a description and a tech story.
  • Write down invoice A's number.
  • Keep the QuickBooks sandbox company open in a second browser tab.
custom_steps:
1. In the QuickBooks tab, search for invoice A's number.
  2. Open invoice A.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • QuickBooks lists invoice A exactly once, for customer A: nothing was sent again.

Step 2:

  • Invoice A opens.
  • Line 1's Description still reads in the old form, starting "What are you doing?:" and carrying ";Why are you doing it?:" and ";Tech Story:": nothing was rewritten in QuickBooks.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It?" (Title and Description), Confluence 845348896, version 15 (14 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11257, story SV-10132 (Story 3, What Reaches QuickBooks)

  • S3-N1: “Invoices already in QuickBooks keep the text they were sent with. Nothing is re-synced to QuickBooks or rewritten there.”
  • S3-R4: “The same text is used by the live QuickBooks sync and by the downloadable Customer Invoice report. Built at the same moment, the two never show different text for the same line. An invoice already in QuickBooks keeps its old text there (S3-N1, S3-E4).”
  • Feature Overview, Out of scope: “Anything already in QuickBooks. Nothing is re-sent, re-exported or rewritten.”
  • Key Decisions: “Nothing already in QuickBooks changes. No backfill, no re-send, no re-export. The new text applies to invoices synced or exported from release day onward. A reversal produces a new invoice, so it carries the new text, which means an invoice and its reversal can read differently in the same books. Accepted deliberately.”

Not yet checked against a build by us: the QA build (sv10130.qa.shopview.com, QuickBooks host qb1.qa.shopview.com) and staging carry this change, and this case has not been run on either.
